clarifications.observation: Jira AC-03 states auto-dismiss = '1 second' (OI-01 resolved), but the PRD still carries a leftover comment '(confirm... assume 3s)'.
clarifications.consequence: Docs out of sync — anyone reading the PRD assumes 3s; test expectations diverge.
clarifications.question: Confirm 1 second is final, and update the PRD to remove the 'assume 3s' comment?

clarifications.observation: AC-04 says playback pauses + icon changes, but does not state whether the controls overlay stays visible or auto-dismisses after pause.
clarifications.consequence: If the overlay disappears immediately, the user must tap again to reach play (extra step); two devs may implement it differently.
clarifications.question: When playback is paused, does the controls overlay stay visible? Does the 1s auto-dismiss timer keep running or stop while paused?
clarifications.answer: The controls overlay stay visible 1s auto-dismiss

clarifications.observation: AC-03 auto-dismisses after 'no further action for 1s'; it doesn't say whether interacting with a control (volume, scrubber) resets the timer.
clarifications.consequence: If the timer doesn't reset, the overlay may vanish while the user is still using the controls.
clarifications.question: Should the 1s auto-dismiss timer reset when the user interacts with an element in the overlay?

clarifications.observation: On web, video + recorded live stream use the same component, but 'Live' live stream uses a different component. The AC bundles 'a video or live stream' in every criterion.
clarifications.consequence: Tap-to-reveal verified on video/recorded LS does not automatically cover 'Live' LS (different render path) — the core fix may not take effect on Live.
clarifications.question: Confirm tap-to-reveal must work identically across video / recorded LS / 'Live' LS? If so, Live must be implemented + tested separately.

clarifications.observation: PRD says pause is bound to 'a central button zone or a double-tap gesture — Design to recommend', but every AC uses only the central button.
clarifications.consequence: If double-tap must still be supported, many more test cases + disambiguation from the single-tap-to-reveal gesture.
clarifications.question: Has the double-tap gesture been descoped (central button being the only method)?

clarifications.observation: AC-02 separates 'tap outside the central button' (dismiss) from tapping the button (pause), but doesn't define the button's hit-target size.
clarifications.consequence: A tap near the button edge resolves as button/surface non-deterministically → pause vs dismiss becomes ambiguous.
clarifications.question: What is the central pause button's hit-target size / spec?
clarifications.answer: I think it same size, refer from figma

clarifications.observation: The new AC-02 requires resume to go to the current live moment. But current behavior on all platforms (iOS, Android, web-desktop) is resume-from-paused-position.
clarifications.consequence: AC-02 is a behavior CHANGE from today's product, not a spec of what exists — dev must implement it anew on every platform, and QA must test the new behavior (not the current one).
clarifications.question: Confirm resume-to-live-moment is the intended new behavior on all supported platforms (replacing today's resume-from-pause)? Any platform exceptions or migration concerns?

clarifications.observation: No AC covers tapping pause at the exact instant the host ends the stream (race condition).
clarifications.consequence: The player may land in an inconsistent state (paused+indicator mixed with the ended state) → broken/stuck UI.
clarifications.question: If pause and stream-end happen simultaneously, which state should win — ended/recorded, or paused?

clarifications.observation: AC-03 moves the player to an ended/recorded state, but doesn't cover the case where the stream ended but the recording is still processing.
clarifications.consequence: The viewer may see a frozen frame or an error while waiting for the recording.
clarifications.question: If the stream ends while paused but the recording isn't ready yet, should an intermediate 'processing' state be shown?

clarifications.observation: The 3 screens (control-appears, tab-media-control, resume-to-live-edge) look identical in the PNG export.
clarifications.consequence: Annotations/interactions may have been lost in export → QA misreads the flow.
clarifications.question: How do LS-mobile-02/03/05 differ in state? Please share the Figma link or annotated frames.

clarifications.observation: The new AC-01 requires 'a visual indicator communicating the stream is paused' (dropped 'behind live edge'). Figma LS-mobile-04 shows a central play (▶) button and no separate badge.
clarifications.consequence: Unclear whether the pause indicator IS the central play-button overlay or a distinct element to design (lower risk than before, since ▶ conveys 'paused').
clarifications.question: Confirm the pause indicator = the central play-button overlay (LS-mobile-04), or is a distinct element required?

clarifications.observation: The new ACs dropped the 'behind live edge' concept (just pause + resume-to-live), but the Jira user_story still reads 'know when I'm paused and behind the live edge'.
clarifications.consequence: Docs inconsistent — anyone reading the user_story will misread the intent vs the ACs.
clarifications.question: Update UC2's user_story to match the new ACs (pause + resume-to-live, drop 'behind live edge')?

clarifications.observation: AC-01/02 skip ±10s per tap but don't specify behavior when the user taps rapidly (e.g. skip-back 3 times quickly).
clarifications.consequence: The final position is unpredictable (−30s or −10s?) → non-deterministic test results.
clarifications.question: Should rapid repeated skip taps accumulate (3 taps = −30s) or be debounced to a single −10s?

clarifications.observation: No behavior is specified for tapping skip while the video is buffering.
clarifications.consequence: May stick on loading or land at the wrong position.
clarifications.question: Should skip while buffering queue until the buffer is ready, or seek-and-rebuffer at the target position?

clarifications.observation: The PRD + story mark UC3 as 'Nice to have… can be descoped if it impacts delivery timeline'.
clarifications.consequence: Affects sprint planning + QA effort — without a decision, the team may invest design/dev/test effort on something that gets cut.
clarifications.question: Is UC3 (10s skip) in this release, or descoped to a follow-on?

clarifications.observation: AC-06 says in-app skip buttons are not shown on live. But Android can fast-forward/rewind live via the OS native media control (iOS/web can't).
clarifications.consequence: No direct conflict (native control != in-app button), but without a scope statement, someone may think seeking on live is fully blocked.
clarifications.question: Confirm AC-06 covers only the in-app overlay buttons? Is native OS media-control scrubbing on live (Android) an acceptable/intended behavior?
clarifications.answer: AC-06 covers only the in-app overlay buttons. The native OS media-control scrubbing on live (Android) is NOT acceptable, it's bug.

clarifications.observation: AC-03 covers 'less than 10 seconds' and AC-04 'within 10 seconds' — but not the exact-10-seconds value.
clarifications.consequence: Off-by-one — if the position is exactly 10s from the start, should skip-back go to 0:00 or stay at 10s?
clarifications.question: When the position is exactly 10 seconds from the start/end, should skip clamp (0:00 / final frame) or skip normally?
clarifications.answer: if the position is exactly 10s from the start, should skip-back go to 0:00. if the position is exactly 10s from the end, should skip to final frame
